title: Abid e beemar
body:
1) BOLI ZAINAB MAI ABID KO BACHAOON KAISE
AAG KHAIMO ME LAGI HAI MAI BUJHAOON KAISE
GASH ME AABID HAI PADEN UNKO JAGAOON KAISE.......
2) TU HAI ZANJIROON ME MUJRIM KI TARAH JAKDA HUWA
TAUQ HAI AABID E BEMAAR KI GARDAN ME PADA
APNE SAJJAD KO IS GHAM SE CHUDAOON KAISE..........
3) GARM RETI HAI TO KHAIMON SE NIKALTA HAI DHUAAN
KAFILA WALOON KO BAITHAOON TO BAITHAOON KAHAN
JAA KE ABBAS SE DARIYA PE BATAOON KAISE............
4) AB NA AYEENGE PALAT KAR KABHI AMMU TERE
CHADREN CHINNE KA LO HO GAYA SAMAN MERE
YE KHABAR BALI SAKINA KO SUNAOON KAISE...........
5) HAR TARAF LASHAI BE SAR HAI PADE MAKHTAL ME
BABA KO DHONDHNE BACHCHI HAI GAI JANGAL ME
LASHA PAMAAL SAKINA KO DIKHAOON KAISE............
6) JALTI RETI HAI JALA JATA HAI BHAI MERA
ROKE BEMAAR SE YE ZAINAB E MUZTAR NE KAHA
HAIN BANDHE HAANTH ME BHAIYYA KO UTHAOON KAISE.......
7) KHAAK PE MAYYATEN URYA HAI PADI BHAI KI
CHADAREN SAR PE NAHI ZULM KI HAD ITNI BADHI
CHOOD KAR BAI KO IS DAST ME JAOON KAISE...........
8) BE KAFAN BHAI BATIJE HAI KAFAN DOON KAISE
SAB TO ZALIM HAIN YAHAAN MANGOON KAFAN MAI KISSE
KHAK ME BHAI KI MAYYAT KO CHUPAOON KAISE............
9) MERE BEMAAR KO KANTOON PE CHALATEN HAI LAEN
BAITHNE DETE NAHI CHAIN SE RAHOON ME KAHIN
HAANT MERE HAI BANDHE ISKO BACHAOON KAISE...........
10) HATHKADI HANTHOON ME PAIROON ME PADI HAI BEDI
AISA DUNIYAN ME KISI NE NAHI DEKHA QAIDI
MAI BHI QAIDI HOON ISE JA KE CHUDAOON KAISE..........
11) AE QAMAR ROK KALAM PHATTA HAI ZAHRA KA JIGAR
IN SHAHEEDOON ME THA EK CHOTA SA BACHCHA ASGHAR
MIL GAYA PANI MAGAR USKO PILAAOON KAISE.................
BIN JANIB ANJUMANE SADQA E ZAHRA KARARI...........................
